adidas-adizero-adios-8: Liked as a light, fast shoe for speed work; a few find it slappy, firm or dead underfoot.
adidas-adizero-adios-9: Praised for a light, sock-like fit and speed on the track; heavy use is hard on the knees for some.
adidas-adizero-adios-pro-4: Loved for a soft, bouncy, fast ride; many go half a size up because the toe box runs narrow.
adidas-adizero-adios-pro-5: Liked for a comfortable, stable ride and roomy toe box; some raise durability concerns.
adidas-adizero-boston-12: Known for firm, very durable build and grippy outsole; many find heel slip and poor lockdown.
adidas-adizero-boston-13: Valued as a stable, secure tempo shoe; firmness is the most common caveat for some.
adidas-adizero-evo-sl: Enjoyed for a light, bouncy feel at faster paces; instability is the main complaint.
adidas-adizero-sl2: Loved for a soft, bouncy, responsive ride; many find the narrow midfoot causes blisters.
adidas-hyperboost-edge: Liked for a bouncy, cushioned ride on easy runs; several find the upper hot or tight.
adidas-supernova-rise-2: Liked as a comfortable, durable everyday trainer; some found the midsole or upper wore out.
altra-olympus-275: Loved for plush cushioning, strong grip and a tough upper; a few note foam wear and foot slide.
asics-gel-trabuco-12: Liked for comfort and good grip on mixed trails; some find the ride dull and low in energy.
asics-glideride-max: Praised as a comfortable, well-cushioned daily trainer; some find it plain rather than exciting.
asics-megablast: Loved for a bouncy, very durable ride; many find the narrow, low toe box causes blisters.
brooks-cascadia-19: Loved for comfort, cushioning and grip on the trail; a few longtime fans find it too soft.
brooks-ghost-amp: Liked for a comfortable, soft and springy ride from easy runs to tempo; few real complaints.
dynafish-xiaonian: Praised as a light, bouncy, versatile trainer that lasts; some criticise the laces and thin insole.
hoka-mach-6: Liked as light, responsive and fun for daily runs; many find the narrow fit the main problem.
hoka-mach-x-2: Enjoyed for a light, springy ride in tempo and long runs; a good share get heel slip and blisters.
hoka-rocket-x-3: Praised as a stable, versatile racer that is not too aggressive; a few find the foam dull.
hoka-speedgoat-7: Liked for comfort and a roomy fit on long, hilly runs; the upper failing early is the main complaint.
hoka-tecton-x-3: Loved for a protective, cushioned plated ride over long distances; some find it unstable.
li-ning-red-hare-9-ultra: Loved as a bouncy, well-cushioned shoe for long runs; some find the fit tight and unstable.
mizuno-neo-zen: Loved for soft, bouncy foam that stays lively; some find it unstable and mushy at faster paces.
new-balance-fuelcell-rebel-v5: Liked for a roomy, comfortable fit and lively ride; some found it too soft or the foam went flat.
nike-alphafly-3: Praised as comfortable, bouncy and stable for racing; many notice noise and some feel the pop fades.
nike-pegasus-plus: Enjoyed as a light, lively shoe with a secure upper; some find the fit snug and tapered.
nike-ultrafly: Liked as a stable, roomy trail shoe that lasts; some dislike the stiff plate and firmness.
nike-vomero-plus: Loved for a plush, durable, bouncy ride; the main complaints are instability and weight.
nike-vomero-premium: Praised for very plush, joint-friendly cushioning; the weight and tall, soft stack feel unstable to some.
nike-zegama-2: Liked as a cushioned, grippy trail shoe that lasts; stability splits opinion and some call it heavy.
nike-zoom-fly-6: Liked as a comfortable, responsive tempo shoe; some find it firm or stiff on long runs.
on-cloudmonster-3-hyper: Praised as a protective trainer that keeps the legs fresh; few real complaints.
on-cloudmonster-hyper: Loved for comfort and a springy ride at faster paces; a few got blisters or heel pain.
puma-deviate-nitro-elite-3: Loved as fast, bouncy and comfortable for PBs; the narrow fit is the main downside.
puma-deviate-nitro-elite-4: Rated for stable, fast racing that also handles long runs; a few prefer the Elite 3.
puma-fast-r-nitro-elite-3: Praised as very light and fast for PBs; the narrow, snug fit is the main downside.
puma-magmax-nitro: Loved as a bouncy, protective, durable shoe for easy miles; some find the weight clunky when quick.
puma-magmax-nitro-2: Liked for a roomy, comfortable fit on easy runs; some want more bounce from the dense foam.
puma-velocity-nitro-4: Liked as a responsive, durable daily trainer; the narrow, snug fit is the main complaint.
salomon-aero-glide-3: Liked as a light, bouncy, versatile daily trainer; some find the midfoot narrow.
salomon-aero-glide-3-grvl: Praised as comfortable, grippy and cushioned on gravel; a few found it firm at first.
salomon-genesis: Valued as a durable, comfortable trail shoe for long technical days; some find the forefoot narrow.
salomon-s-lab-genesis: Loved for a precise, secure fit and grip on technical trails; few real complaints.
saucony-endorphin-azura: Liked as a firm, stable, light do-it-all trainer; some find it very firm or harsh.
saucony-endorphin-elite-2: Loved for a soft, fast ride and very comfortable upper; several find it wobbly at slow speeds.
saucony-endorphin-speed-5: Liked as a firm, stable, light shoe for speed sessions; several call it flat or harsh.
saucony-hurricane-25: Loved as a stable, well-cushioned shoe for easy and long runs; a few find the toe box narrow.
saucony-ride-18: Liked as a comfortable trainer; several find the ride flat or dead.
saucony-triumph-24: Loved as a light, soft yet bouncy daily trainer with good energy return; few real complaints.
